expected_observable_behavior.zh: 第7天起匀速段速度波动幅度明显增大。
expected_observable_behavior.en: From day 7 the speed ripple during constant-speed segments grows markedly.

expected_health_response.en: NORMAL before day 7; WARNING/CRITICAL after day 8.

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.
